title: agent_deploy output
description: Have the network serve the agent of an MCP server on the web: agent.json, the server's address and headers and the agent key are checked, the server is probed and the deploy is recorded as a revision; when its checks pass the revision is announced at the agent's relay address and becomes the active one.

revision_status.description: active when its checks passed and it is served; failed when they did not, and the previous active revision stays.

digest.description: SHA-256 of what was deployed; a deploy with the same digest as the active revision records nothing.

unchanged.description: True when nothing changed since the active revision.

endpoint.description: The agent's relay address, announced as its endpoint.

announced_version.description: The agent.json version this revision announced, if it passed.

waiting_for_review.description: A version waiting for the publisher's review, if any.

checks.description: The checks of this revision: mcp_server (the server answers MCP) and agent_file (agent.json against the server's tools), each with check, ok, message and, for agent_file, problems.

availability.description: What a caller meets: serving (running now), sleeping (started by the next call, within 15 s), failed (no revision passed its checks) or removed.

callbacks.description: Where the agent's own decisions are made: hosted (its callbacks file, run by the network), route (a route in the publisher's own app), or null when its console rules decide.

checks.message: agent.json passes the network's checks against the server's tools
